item.title: The Connection to Data Plane Failed
item.author: Autor
item.description: The connection to Data Plane failed No será la primera vez —ni probablemente la última— que reciba un caso en el que un cliente reporta desde el portal de Azure que, al intentar acceder a un Key Vault configurado para permitir acceso únicamente mediante Private Endpoint, aparece el siguiente error: “The connection to data plane failed. Please refresh and try again. If Private Links are enabled on the vault and the issue persists please follow the steps in the following link:
